note: Synthetic, read-only complexity-review fixtures. Correctness is a constraint on suggested simplifications, not replaced by a line-count target.

evals.prompt: Complexity-only review, no edits or tool execution. Fixture: existing src/keys.ts exports makeKey(account,id), already tested. A diff adds src/key-service.ts with a factory and a one-implementation class whose only method repeats makeKey exactly; src/report.ts is its only consumer. There is no public extension contract. Give the actionable review finding and the evidence/check needed to remove this duplication.
assertions: Identify the duplicated factory/class and name the existing src/keys.ts makeKey replacement.
Ground the recommendation in the supplied consumer evidence, and retain or rerun the relevant makeKey/report behavior check.
Return a scoped complexity finding without claiming compilation or scanner execution, inventing line numbers, or applying edits.

evals.prompt: Complexity-only review, no edits or tool execution. Fixture: a published plugin SDK has one in-tree implementation of a reader interface. Third-party implementations load dynamically by registered name. Its input guard rejects paths outside an allowed root. A proposal deletes the interface and guard because there is only one implementation in this repository. Should this simplification be recommended?
assertions: Reject the proposed deletion: the interface has a supplied external/dynamic contract despite one in-tree implementation.
Retain the trust-boundary path guard rather than equating fewer checks with less unnecessary complexity.
Do not fabricate a replacement, caller search, measured line saving, or successful test run.

evals.prompt: Complexity-only review, no edits or tool execution. Fixture: one private Rust function returns s.trim().to_lowercase(); the contract requires exactly that behavior and existing tests cover empty input and mixed case. No abstraction, duplicate helper or unused dependency is present. Report any justified complexity reduction.
assertions: Report that no justified complexity reduction is established; do not invent a finding.
Do not recommend changing required trimming/case behavior or deleting its tests to save lines.
Keep the response brief and do not invent a score, measured saving, tool execution or edits.

should_trigger: Review this diff for unnecessary complexity.
What can we safely delete instead of adding another abstraction?
should_not_trigger: Why did this production request time out? (near-miss: root-cause)
Rewrite the README in a warmer voice. (near-miss: human-writing)

baseline.method: Existing unslop guidance supplied to the same fresh baseline agent for three synthetic review tasks.
baseline.finding: No missing complexity-review behavior demonstrated; the skill body is intentionally not expanded.
